import bpy,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
cap=root/'captures'/'shipyard_props_20261111'
cap.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2(bpy.data.filepath,cap/'before_props.blend')
shutil.copy2(root/'assets/coast/shipyard_combined.glb',cap/'before_props.glb')
report=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if any(k in (o.name+' '+o.get('source_component','')).lower() for k in ['bench','lifeb','ring','tool','barrel','coil']):
  report.append({'name':o.name,'source':o.get('source_component',''),'type':o.type,'loc':list(o.location),'dims':list(o.dimensions),'mat':[m.name if m else '' for m in o.data.materials],'verts':len(o.data.vertices) if o.type=='MESH' else 0,'mods':[(m.name,m.type) for m in o.modifiers]})
(cap/'prop_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print(json.dumps([r for r in report if any(k in (r['name']+' '+r['source']).lower() for k in ['bench','life','tool'])],ensure_ascii=False))
print('TOTAL_PROP_COMPONENTS',len(report))
